title: A X O L O T L
body: This mod adds many things related to Axolotls. For instance, there is a new Axolotl Dimension. You will make a portal frame out of Bloxolotl (Axolotl Blocks) and ignite it using the Flint and Axolotl, both of which you can get from trading with a special new villager, which you can get by placing down pink concrete around a villager without a profession. There is also a new potion which will spawn Axolotls, craftable by putting a bucket of Axolotl in a brewing stand and making the new potion. The new dimension is a vast landscape of Axolotl blocks and large oceans made of liquid Axolotl. On top of that, there is a brand new banner pattern!
